site.name: France Economic Pulse
site.tagline: French industry in real time, ahead of the official figures
overview.title: Industrial production: real-time estimate
overview.description: An estimate of French industrial production before INSEE publishes it, built from open data updated every day.
overview.up: French industrial output likely rose {g} in {month}
overview.down: French industrial output likely fell {g} in {month}
overview.flat: French industrial output was likely flat in {month}
overview.lede: Estimate made on {date} from electricity consumption, business surveys, company insolvencies and interest rates. Latest official INSEE figure: {official_g} in {official_month}.
overview.chart_desc: Index published by INSEE, then the estimate for months not yet published, with an 80% range.
overview.table_caption: Months INSEE has not published yet
overview.track_title: How far can you trust it?
overview.track: Tested on {n} months since {from} (excluding the pandemic), the estimate got the direction right {hit} times out of 10, against {hit_ar} for a naive forecast. Its average error is {gain} smaller than the naive forecast’s: an encouraging gain, but not yet statistically proven.
overview.track_link: Read the method and full track record
indicators.title: Indicators
indicators.description: The four open series behind the estimate: weather-corrected electricity, business climate, insolvency openings and the France–Germany yield spread.
indicators.intro: Each series updates automatically from its source. Values are monthly.
ind.electricity.note: National consumption, corrected for temperature, day of the week and month. It is the signal most closely tied to month-to-month production.
ind.climate.note: INSEE’s summary of its business surveys, all sectors.
ind.insolvencies.note: Safeguard, receivership and liquidation proceedings opened, from BODACC notices.
ind.spread.note: The gap between French and German 10-year government bond yields: a measure of perceived risk on France.
method.title: Method and track record
method.description: How the estimate is built, tested and published, with its full error history and its limits.
method.backtest_desc: Monthly change in industrial production, %. Each estimate uses only the data available on its date.
method.score_caption: Errors excluding the pandemic (March to July 2020)
fresh.title: Data freshness
